subject.title: chore(deps-dev): bump the development-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should this dependency bundle keep the @react-email/ui 6.6.6 and Vite 8.1.3 updates despite the Socket obfuscated-code warnings, or should those updates be split/held?
rationale: The formatter failure is mechanical, but accepting new obfuscated-code supply-chain warnings is a security-risk choice automation should not make.

options.title: Hold flagged updates
options.body: Drop or split the @react-email/ui and Vite updates that introduced Socket alerts, keep the safer dependency bumps, then include the oxfmt formatting output.

options.title: Accept after secops review
options.body: Keep the full bundle only if the security owner accepts the Socket warnings and the formatter failure is fixed before merge.

options.title: Close and wait for a cleaner bundle
options.body: Let Dependabot regenerate a smaller update if repairing this grouped PR is not worth the review overhead.

recommendation.title: Hold flagged updates
recommendation.body: Drop or split the @react-email/ui and Vite updates that introduced Socket alerts, keep the safer dependency bumps, then include the oxfmt formatting output.

likelyOwner.reason: The open question is whether the new Socket obfuscation alerts are acceptable supply-chain risk.
